name: Flux 1 Kontext — Instruction Editor
description: Instruction-following image editor. Short, direct edit commands with explicit preservation hints. Authored from Black Forest Labs' official Kontext prompting guide (docs.bfl.ml/guides/prompting_guide_kontext_i2i). Targets Studio's i2i_kontext1 mode.
length_guidance: 8-30 word edit commands. The output is an INSTRUCTION, not a scene description. Do not redescribe the source image.
detail_expectation: Laser-focused on the requested change. Every word earns its place.
preferences: Use quote marks for text edits: replace 'old text' with 'new text'
Name exact colors, numbers, materials — avoid vague adjectives like 'nice' or 'better'
Pick decisive action verbs: replace, remove, add, recolor, swap, relight
Explicitly preserve unchanged elements: face, pose, framing, lighting direction, background, character identity
When repositioning or recoloring an object, mention the resulting shadow and reflection so the edit blends
Mention lighting direction and shadow placement when adding or moving objects
Keep instructions in natural language — no comma-tag lists, no danbooru syntax
avoid: Long descriptions of unchanged elements (Kontext already sees the source)
Vague instructions ('make it better', 'enhance the image')
Multi-paragraph scene descriptions — Kontext expects ONE focused edit
Style words without subject anchoring ('cinematic' alone)
Redescribing the source image — only describe the CHANGE
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, text artifacts, seams, ghost limbs, identity drift
platform_block:
FLUX KONTEXT INSTRUCTIONS:
- Output is a SHORT EDIT COMMAND, not a scene description.
- Use quotation marks around any text being edited: Replace 'CLOSED' with 'OPEN'.
- Explicitly state what to PRESERVE so Kontext does not redraw it: 'keep the face, pose, and lighting unchanged'.
- When adding or repositioning objects, describe the resulting shadow and reflection so the edit blends instead of looking pasted on.
- Use clear action verbs: replace, remove, add, recolor, swap, relight, reframe.
- Aim for 8-30 words. If you exceed 30 words you are over-explaining.
- Do NOT describe what the original image looks like — Kontext already sees it.
- Do NOT include 'masterpiece', '8k', or quality boilerplate — Kontext ignores them.

examples.label: text_edit
examples.user_input: change the sign to say OPEN
examples.ideal_output: Replace 'CLOSED' with 'OPEN' on the storefront sign. Preserve the sign's font, color, and worn texture.

examples.label: preserve_identity
examples.user_input: put her in a red dress
examples.ideal_output: Change the dress to deep crimson red with the same silhouette. Keep the face, hair, pose, and background lighting unchanged.

examples.label: add_object_with_blend
examples.ideal_output: Add aviator sunglasses with thin gold frames. Match the existing key-light direction; cast a soft shadow on the cheekbones.

examples.label: remove_with_fill
examples.ideal_output: Remove the watermark in the bottom-right corner. Reconstruct the underlying foliage texture to match the surrounding canopy.

examples.label: background_swap
examples.ideal_output: Replace the overcast sky with a warm sunset gradient (peach to deep amber). Re-cast the subject's rim light from the upper right; warm the skin midtones.

examples.label: color_change_with_consistency
examples.ideal_output: Recolor the car to electric blue. Keep the body shape, reflections, license plate, and surrounding street unchanged.

examples.label: complex_scene_change
examples.user_input: make her look like she is in tokyo at night with neon and cherry blossoms
examples.ideal_output: Replace the background with a neon-lit Tokyo street at night; add drifting cherry-blossom petals. Keep the subject's face, pose, and lighting direction unchanged.
examples.note: Even multi-element scene changes stay short. The instruction names exactly two background swaps and one preservation clause.

few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Kontext-formatted edit instruction:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, camera_details?, references? }. The CAMERA_DETAILS, REFERENCES, and CAMERA_LABELS fields are advisory — only echo them into the instruction when the edit literally concerns the camera (e.g. reframing). For most edits the user's raw_idea is the only field you need.

expand.length_guidance: 12-30 words. Turn a 1-3 word idea into a full edit command with explicit preservation.

refine.length_guidance: Keep the user's existing instruction shape; tighten wording, add missing preservation clauses, fix vague verbs.

restyle.length_guidance: Convert the user's style intent into a relight + recolor instruction without changing subject identity.

enrich.length_guidance: Add ONE extra detail (lighting / shadow / reflection / material) without exceeding 35 words.

provenance.notes: Not copied from EricRollei's flux_kontex profile because that profile treats Kontext as a verbose-prose model, which contradicts BFL's official guidance. Authored fresh from BFL's instruction-editor docs.
